description:
Introducing the Eskute NOVA 01 Electric Dirt Bike – built for the ultimate off-road experience. Combining a 2500W peak motor with superior stability, it empowers riders to explore aggressively while maintaining maximum safety and control.

Experience the next level of electric motocross with the NOVA 01. Engineered for riders who demand stability, responsive handling, and explosive performance, this e-dirt bike is built to take on everything from rugged mountain trails to challenging, uneven terrain. Whether you're chasing adrenaline on the trails or looking for an exhilarating everyday ride, the NOVA 01 delivers a thrilling experience with professional-grade performance wherever the ride takes you.

Dominate the terrain with a massive 2500W peak brushless motor that delivers a crushing 135 N·m of torque. Capable of reaching speeds of 26–37 MPH, it tackles 45° slopes with ease. The instant throttle response and 7-speed allow you to tailor power for any challenge, ensuring you have the explosive performance needed for extreme off-road climbs.

Powered by a premium 52V 30Ah Lithium Battery, the NOVA 01 offers an impressive range of 70-100 miles on a single charge. This TUV-certified battery pack is built for durability and safety, supporting hundreds of charge cycles so you can explore further without range anxiety.

Ride with confidence knowing you have professional-grade Full Suspension (front and rear) that absorbs bumps and potholes, reducing fatigue on long trips. Stopping power is handled by Dual Hydraulic Disc Brakes, providing fade-free, precise control in wet or muddy conditions, ensuring your safety at high speeds.Built on a high-strength steel frame supporting up to 360 lbs, this bike is ready for heavy-duty use. It rolls on aggressive 19" x 3.4" Fat Tires that provide superior grip on sand, mud, gravel, and snow, while the wide footprint enhances stability and cushioning on rough paths.

Stay informed with the Color LCD Display, tracking your speed, battery life, and mode in real-time. The bike arrives mostly pre-assembled with illustrated instructions—simply attach the remaining parts using the step-by-step guide, and you are ready to ride in no time, hassle-free.

Ride with confidence. Ride with Eskute Nova 01.
